documented_probe: C-7ea828f8 (respect one-use-only and allowed-number constraints): every number used in the emitted expression must belong to the allowed pool and no occurrence may be used more than once. The verifier re-executes the solver on hidden configs (subset solutions, duplicate pool values, negative targets, and a genuinely impossible target) and independently parses/evaluates each expression to enforce membership, one-use-per-occurrence, and exact target evaluation.
notes: Easy: single-deliverable search program with a crisp validity contract. Small rubric weight for reasoning_depth (subset DP over numbers with expression reconstruction), adversarial_inputs/hidden_case_generalization (dupes, negatives, impossibility), and quantitative_correctness (exact evaluation). No tool breadth, no dependency chain, no environment pressure.
